sourceTitle: How to make Chilli Paneer Cheese Toast
sourceText:
How to make Chilli Paneer Cheese Toast
By: ravikumar
Published: Friday, September 8, 2017 - 11:46pm

Ingredients




5 tbsp Ching's Schezwan Chutney
Ching's Schezwan Fried Rice Masala
5 Pieces Bread Slice
1 Cup Grated Cheese
1 Chopped Onion
½ Chopped Capsicum
2 tbsp Butter
100 gm Small Cubes of Paneer
Chopped Coriander

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Spread butter on the bread and toast it in the oven for 2-3 minutes at 180 degree C. 3 Step 2: 4 In a bowl add cheese, onion, capsicum , paneer cubes, Chings Secret Schezwan chutney and mix well. 5 Step 3: 6 Now Spread some Chings Secret schezwan chutney on the bread. Once that is done, spread the paneer mixture on the bread. Sprinkle some chopped coriander leaves on top. 7 Step 4: 8 Put it back in the oven and cook for 6-8 minutes. Remove from the oven and cut the toast into two equal pieces. 9 Serve Hot!!

About

Chilli Paneer Cheese Toast is simple and quick to make, the recipe for Chilli Paneer Cheese Toast is awesome in taste. You can serve it at breakfast, snacks time and whenever you feel hungry. This Chilli Paneer Cheese Toast, with its rich mouth-feel and irresistible aroma, is both a sumptuous and tasteful treat!
